Wyoming vs Delaware vs New Mexico LLC: Which US State is Best for International Founders?

An in-depth legal and financial masterclass for non-US residents evaluating Wyoming, Delaware, and New Mexico LLCs on state taxes, annual maintenance fees, privacy laws, asset protection, and investor appeal.

ADVAQ US Legal Advisory Team
15 Min Read · Updated July 2026
US Corporate State Law Analysis
State Comparison Verdict
Wyoming (Best Overall)

Best for solopreneurs, freelancers & e-commerce. 0% state tax, $62 annual fee, member privacy.

Delaware (VC Founders)

Best for venture-backed tech startups raising US capital. $300 annual tax, Chancery Court equity laws.

New Mexico (Budget Anonymity)

Best for privacy-focused bootstrappers. $0 annual state fees, anonymous member registration.

1. Wyoming LLC: The Gold Standard for Solopreneurs

Wyoming enacted the first Limited Liability Company statute in the United States in 1977 and remains the premier state for foreign entrepreneurs.

Key Advantages of Wyoming:

  • 0% State Income Tax: Wyoming imposes no state corporate or personal income tax.
  • Low Annual Maintenance: Annual report filing fee is only $62 per year for companies with under $300k of Wyoming assets.
  • Member Privacy: Owner and manager names are not published in public Secretary of State online databases.
  • Charging Order Protection: Protects multi-member and single-member LLC assets from personal creditors.

2. Delaware LLC: The Choice for Venture-Backed Startups

Over 68% of Fortune 500 companies are incorporated in Delaware. Delaware is internationally renowned for its sophisticated Court of Chancery, which specializes exclusively in corporate equity disputes.

However, Delaware is more expensive for small non-resident businesses: it imposes a mandatory annual Franchise Tax of $300/year due every June 1st, regardless of income.

3. New Mexico LLC: The Zero Annual Fee Budget Pick

New Mexico is unique among US states because it requires $0 annual report fees and zero annual filings after initial incorporation.

It also offers strong member privacy (anonymous LLC status). However, New Mexico lacks the established legal case law of Wyoming and Delaware.

5. How to Choose the Right State for Your Business

If you are an international freelancer, agency owner, Amazon FBA seller, or SaaS founder self-funding your business, Wyoming is the clear #1 choice due to its low annual fees ($62/yr) and privacy. Choose Delaware only if you plan to seek US venture capital funding.
